window.title: Moviva FBX → VRM
header.subtitle: FBX → VRM avatar converter
intro.placeholder: Your 3D character   →   your avatar, talking in a call
step.1: Drop a rigged character: FBX, GLB or glTF
step.2: Wait a minute or two: everything runs on this computer
step.3: Load the VRM into {moviva} and talk as your avatar in calls
drop.title: Drop your character here
drop.hint: FBX, GLB or glTF with a skeleton · or click to choose
autoface: Create missing blinking, lip sync and expressions when the face allows it
footer: v{version} · Blender and the VRM Add-on are built in · GPL-3.0
progress.hint: Big models take a few minutes. You can keep working meanwhile.
verdict.limited: Your avatar is ready, with limits.
advice.limited: It loads and moves; the parts marked red will not work with this model.
crash.headline: The conversion stopped unexpectedly.
crash.advice: The model may be too big or damaged. {fix}
fix: Fix it in Blender (or the tool the model came from), export the FBX again and retry.
error.no-armature.title: The model has no skeleton.
error.no-armature.advice: Only rigged characters can be converted. Rig it first (Mixamo's auto-rigger is free), then export the rigged FBX.
error.no-skinned-mesh.title: The skeleton does not move the body.
error.no-skinned-mesh.advice: The meshes are not skinned to the bones. Bind the mesh to the armature (weights) and export again.
error.humanoid-incomplete.title: The skeleton is not recognisable as a human.
error.humanoid-incomplete.advice: Bones that every avatar needs (hips, spine, head, arms, legs) are missing or unclear. A standard humanoid rig (Mixamo, Character Creator, VRoid, Rigify) works best.
error.humanoid-invalid.title: The skeleton is not recognisable as a human.
error.humanoid-invalid.advice: The bone hierarchy is broken (for example an arm attached to a leg). {fix}
error.ambiguous-armature.title: The file holds more than one character.
error.ambiguous-armature.advice: Keep only one character in the file and export again.
error.armature-not-found.title: The chosen skeleton is not in the file.
error.unsupported-format.title: This file type is not supported.
error.source-missing.title: The file could not be found.
error.source-missing.advice: It may have been moved or deleted. Choose it again.
error.import-failed.title: Blender could not open the file.
error.import-failed.advice: The file may be damaged or come from a newer FBX version. Open it in Blender, export it again (FBX or GLB) and retry.
error.importer-missing.title: Blender could not open the file.
error.export-failed.title: Writing the VRM failed.
error.invalid-output.title: The VRM came out broken.
error.unsafe-geometry-drop.title: A part needed for the avatar would have been removed.
body.missing: Missing bones: {bones}. The avatar cannot move.
body.ok: All {count} core bones found; head, arms and spine will move.
fingers.ok: Finger bones found; hands can gesture.
fingers.one: Only one hand has finger bones; the other hand stays stiff.
fingers.none: No finger bones: hands move as a whole, fingers stay still. Add finger bones to the rig if you need finger gestures.
blink.none: No eyelid shapes found: the avatar will not blink. Models with facial blend shapes (ARKit, VRoid, Character Creator) fix this.
lips.some: Only some mouth shapes found ({found}): speech looks simplified.
lips.none: No mouth shapes found: the avatar moves and talks, but its lips stay still. Use a model with facial blend shapes (visemes or ARKit) for lip sync.
moods.some: Only {found}; other emotions show through the body only.
moods.none: No facial emotions; the avatar shows mood through gestures only.
eyes.none: No eye bones or eye shapes: the gaze stays fixed.
hair.static: Hair is static: it has no bones to sway with.
weight.heavy: {triangles} triangles, {size}: heavy, slow to load and to animate on weaker computers and phones. Decimate the mesh or shrink textures for a lighter avatar.
autorig.title: Generated skeleton
autorig.detail: The skeleton and skin weights were generated from the geometry ({method}). Pose tests: {status}. Check arms, legs and head in a viewer before using the avatar.
geometry.title: Visible part
geometry.help: Everything below the cut is removed from the file: triangles, vertices, skin weights, shape-key data, and materials and textures nothing else uses. The bones stay (VRM requires them). The avatar loads faster and costs the GPU less. Video call is what Moviva shows; choose Full body for other VRM apps that show the legs.
